# DocuPost

DocuPost is a print and mail service that enables users to send digital files as physical letters and postcards via the U.S. Postal Service.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docupost/.

## Actions

- **Send Letter**: Send a letter via u.s.
- **Send Postcard**: Send a postcard via u.s.
